Subject: Saffron Tech vendor record change — quick checklist and next steps

Hi Carl —

Thanks again for the heads-up on Saffron's banking and remit-address change. To make the internal update smooth and avoid PO/invoice breaks, finance asked for a short implementation checklist we can follow. Below is what we need from you and the proposed timeline. If you can confirm the items you’ll provide today, I’ll open the vendor-change ticket with AP and set up the PO reroute.

Required from Saffron (please attach where possible):
- Completed bank authorization form (signed) — Excel/PDF
- Updated W-9 / tax form (if US entity)
- New remit-to address and billing contact (name, email, phone)
- Confirmation of effective date for new bank (date window)

Proposed timeline:
- Day 0 (today): vendor sends bank auth + W-9 + new contacts
- Day 1: Redwood AP validates bank details, security sign-off (finance)
- Day 2–3: PO routing change for active POs; test invoice processed

Cc'ing Marissa (Ops) and Marcus (Finance) to coordinate validation and the short cutover window.

One ask: if Saffron can send a low-res screenshot of the bank confirmation from their bank portal (redacted) it speeds up verification.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
